item.description: In a nail-biting showdown at the Hockey World Cup, India triumphed over Pakistan, much to the delight of fans. Captain Harmanpreet Singh highlighted essential defensive weaknesses that need addressing for the challenges ahead. With praises from the coach regarding the team's attacking strategy and chances created, India now look forward to battle in the next round, where the competition will only intensify.

item.title: Meet 10-yr-old Hsu Ting-wei, winner of Silicon Valley invention award
item.description: In a remarkable showcase of talent, Taiwanese inventors made waves at the Silicon Valley International Festival. Among them, a ten-year-old prodigy captured prestigious awards with his innovative AI-powered electronic nose, designed to identify airborne chemical threats and health risks. The event highlighted the impressive achievement of Taiwanese participants, who collectively earned twenty-four gold medals, demonstrating the practical benefits of emerging technologies in daily life.

item.title: 'Legal cockroaches united': CJP hails planned protest for Bar chief's resignation
item.description: A protest is planned against the Bar Council of India chairman over a withdrawn directive. The All India Young Advocates Association will demonstrate demanding his resignation. This follows the chairman's apology to law students regarding the NALSAR University controversy. The initial directive barred NALSAR graduating students from becoming advocates. The controversy involved a campaign against the Chief Justice of India's convocation participation.
item.dc:creator: TOI CITY DESK

item.title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18
item.description: Beginning September 18, 2026, new rules from the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services will reshape the Green Card application landscape. Applicants will undergo a more rigorous public charge evaluation that now includes a broader range of public benefits. Additionally, previous cash assistance and long-term institutional stays will factor into decisions, significantly affecting family and employment-based immigration cases.

item.title: California seized Black couple's beach resort; heirs later got it back
item.description: In a remarkable turn of events, the Bruce family has regained ownership of their century-old beachfront property, unjustly seized from them in the past. Following this victory, they have transferred it back to Los Angeles County for approximately $20 million. This land, a cherished destination for African Americans during segregation, will now be utilized for lifeguard training facilities.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: US tech firm asks court to block CEO who fired 900 in 79-second call
item.description: Better Home & Finance is suing former CEO Vishal Garg in a US court. The company seeks to block Garg from gathering shareholder support for his return. Garg allegedly violated securities laws by making misleading statements to regain his position. The board unanimously removed Garg after significant company losses and stock decline. Garg seeks reinstatement, offering to work for one dollar annually.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Former wrestler arrested in Delhi opium case; claims drug use in ‘akhadas’
item.description: In a dramatic turn of events, Delhi Police have arrested Amit Sheoran, a former national-level wrestler, after he spent three years on the run from charges of opium smuggling. Sheoran's claims that fellow wrestlers resort to opium to enhance training efforts have stirred controversy. His identification as a key figure by another arrested supplier highlights the ongoing battle against organised crime in the region.

item.title: Hockey WC: India extend dominance over Pakistan with 5-3 thriller, seal next-round spot
item.description: In a thrilling Pool D showdown, India triumphed over Pakistan with a score of 5-3. With Harmanpreet Singh and Abhishek each netting two goals, India showcased their strength. Pakistan's Hannan Shahid and Sufyan Khan put up a valiant effort by scoring, yet India held their ground during the nail-biting final quarter, securing their advancement to the next stage of the World Cup.

item.title: Saints rookie Brock Rechsteiner, Scott Steiner's son, suplexes teammate
item.description: Brock Rechsteiner, the Saints rookie and son of WWE Hall of Famer Scott Steiner, became part of a heated Saints-Cowboys practice fight after giving Jalen Thompson a German suplex. Rechsteiner is trying to earn an NFL roster spot after joining New Orleans as an undrafted receiver, while his six-game suspension will keep him out of the start of the regular season.

item.description: Fortnite's island undergoes a major overhaul for Chapter 7 Season 4 Override. New gaming-themed points of interest will be introduced to the island. Iconic locations like Sonic's Green Hill Zone are arriving with the update. Several existing points of interest will be removed and replaced by new ones. The map changes promise a visually distinct and gameplay-rich experience for players.

item.description: Minnesota Wild and Ottawa Senators face important contract talks soon. Quinn Hughes seeks a shorter deal, while Drake Batherson wants a longer one. item.title: 'Every Test match victory is special': KL Rahul after 165-run victory vs SL
item.description: KL Rahul said India’s 165-run win over Sri Lanka boosted confidence in handling spin-friendly conditions. He praised the team for executing its plans and credited thorough preparation for their success. Rahul also lauded Devdutt Padikkal’s maiden Test century, calling it a defining moment that helped set up the victory and hoping the young batter carries his confidence into future matches.

item.title: From Taco Tuesday to Fitting Friday: Trump puts Canada tariffs on ice for 72 hours
item.description: Canada avoided a significant tariff imposition after a last-minute reprieve. President Trump announced a three-day extension for trade negotiations with Canada. Substantial progress has been acknowledged, though significant work remains to finalize an agreement. The immediate dispute centers on Canadian trade practices and market access for American goods. Both nations aim to resolve these issues before the extended deadline expires.
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: 'Speechless' Garret Tan silences Lakshya Sen and Delhi crowd at BWF World C'ships
item.description: American teenager Garret Tan stunned Lakshya Sen, the 14th seed and the 2021 World Championships bronze medallist, in a thrilling three-set match at the Delhi World Championships. Overcoming crowd pressure, a head injury and Sen’s aggressive play, Tan triumphed 19-21, 21-19, 21-17, marking the biggest win of his career.
item.dc:creator: TANUJ LAKHINA

item.title: Khabib's 2018 warning to Gleison Tibau about Makhachev goes viral again
item.description: Khabib Nurmagomedov foresaw Islam Makhachev's exceptional talent years ago. He issued a warning about Makhachev's advanced skills before a key fight. Makhachev then delivered a swift knockout, validating Nurmagomedov's early assessment. He later became a dominant two-division UFC champion and record holder. Nurmagomedov consistently supported Makhachev's remarkable championship journey.

item.description: Rhea Ripley and Bianca Belair are still two of the biggest WWE women’s division stars, with both women earning a lot of money from wrestling contracts, merchandise, premium live events and commercial opportunities. item.title: "He was always there for me": Jayson Tatum's son, his source of strength
item.description: Jayson Tatum’s rise to NBA superstardom has been alongside his son, Jayson “Deuce” Tatum Jr., the teenage father who’s now a father himself. Deuce was born right as Tatum entered the NBA and has been a steady emotional anchor ever since. From Celtics celebrations to injury recovery, his father has climbed the league, and he’s been a source of joy, perspective and steadfast belief.

item.title: Govt planning to bring E10 back? Clamour grows after top bureaucrat's remark
item.description: E20 is petrol containing 20% ethanol and 80% petrol. The government has promoted higher ethanol blending as a way to reduce crude oil imports, save foreign exchange and improve India's energy security. India also achieved its 20% blending target ahead of the original 2030 deadline. However, the nationwide shift has generated concerns among some vehicle owners, particularly those with older vehicles.

item.description: Pakistan's opening batsman, Azan Awais, faced an unfortunate fate as he was dismissed on the very first ball of the Test match by a brilliant lbw delivery from Ollie Robinson. Joining the ranks of elite England bowlers, Robinson's stellar performance continued, leading to him claiming four wickets. Pakistan struggled significantly, reaching just 150/7 by the tea break, after Robinson's dominant spell.

item.description: In a remarkable display of skill, Manav Suthar claimed ten wickets, leading India to a triumphant victory over Sri Lanka in Galle. Devdutt Padikkal showcased his talent with an impressive 167 in the first innings, followed by 44 in the second. Captain Shubman Gill praised their performances, emphasising the importance of this win for India's aspirations in the World Test Championship.

item.title: BWF Worlds: Shetty, Sindhu into pre-quarters; Lakshya, Unnati suffer exits
item.description: Ayush Shetty and PV Sindhu advanced to the BWF World Championships pre-quarterfinals with straight-game wins. Shetty beat Dumindu Abeywickrama and will face Alwi Farhan next, while Sindhu defeated Wen Yu Zhang. Lakshya Sen suffered a three-game upset against Garret Tan, and Unnati Hooda lost a close battle to Michelle Li. India also progressed in mixed and men’s doubles.

item.title: Modi govt's Gen Z outreach: One Union minister to visit one university every day
item.description: The proposed initiative, called 'One Day, One University', is aimed at strengthening the government's engagement with young people. During these visits, ministers are expected to hold discussions with students, hear their views on issues affecting the country and explain government schemes meant for students and young people. The plan comes at a time when student protests over the NEET paper leak issue have intensified in parts of the country.
item.dc:creator: RAJEEV SINGH

item.title: ‘It was like a horror movie’: Kolkata hotel fire survivors recount night of terror
item.description: A devastating fire in a Kolkata hotel claimed nine lives early Wednesday morning. Survivors recounted a night of terror as dark smoke engulfed the building's upper floors. Many guests alleged the establishment lacked essential fire alarms and adequate safety equipment. Prompt action by fire brigade personnel saved approximately eighty lives from the dangerous blaze. An investigation is underway to determine the exact cause and potential safety regulation violations.

item.title: 4,000-year-old painted stone in Indonesia reveals art carried by ancient Austronesians
item.description: A painted stone found on Indonesia's Wetar Island offers ancient insights. This artifact dates back over 4,000 years and shows early artistic traditions. The artwork predates Neolithic pottery, revealing a significant cultural development. Portable symbols likely traveled with Austronesian voyagers across islands. This discovery reshapes our understanding of ancient maritime cultural exchanges.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: 3 killed, 3 injured after truck gas tank explodes at Delhi CNG station
item.description: A fire service officer said all six injured people were taken to hospital, where they were receiving treatment. Further information about the rest three is awaited. Fire service personnel also took precautionary measures at the station and worked to bring the situation under control. The cause of the explosion has not yet been established. An investigation is underway to determine what led to the gas tank bursting.

item.description: Ahead of the 2026 CPKC Women’s Open in Edmonton, Wayne Gretzky and his wife Janet have sent a message of encouragement to Danielle Kang. She drew support after donning an Edmonton Oilers No. 99 jersey, a nod to her relationship with the hockey legend. The LPGA star will be teeing it up at Royal Mayfair Golf Club August 20-23.
